MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED

What the model gets right.
And how far it can miss.

The figures below evaluate the trained tabular baseline. E5-enhanced results are pending.

A holdout the model didn’t learn from

A fixed 10% sample was drawn from the original database before filtering. Eligibility checks and text/VIN deduplication precede a chronological 70/15/15 split. Validation selects Huber settings; test rows do not select the winner.

The baseline has no description-price feature, so its training does not use the E5-price Isolation Forest filter. The requested enhanced workflow applies that filter only to training OOF text prices.

A LOOK UNDER THE BONNET

Details in.
A price you can examine.

01

Names stay categories

Make and model enter LightGBM as ordinary categorical fields alongside mileage, year and other vehicle details. No transformer or separate price model is fitted to those names.

02

Descriptions get their own signal

The GPU workflow fine-tunes E5-base on seller descriptions and log prices. Three-fold predictions create predicted_text_price without using each row’s own price to train its predictor.

TRAINING PENDING
03

Filter, then combine

Isolation Forest uses automatic contamination on training OOF text prices only. It determines the removal count; validation/test remain unfiltered. Huber LightGBM then combines the text-price signal with the structured fields.

E5 MODE ONLY

Keep the date in the picture

These are US asking prices from April–May 2021. They are not transaction prices, present-day appraisals or inflation-adjusted values. The error band is calibrated on validation residuals; its actual test coverage is reported in Model results.
